model.name: Unreachable methods — 3 methods are in no Class, a user cannot navigate to them at all @390
model.description: USER-VISIBLE DEFECT (architect prod sweep, served v0.8.150). 3 Method units are in NO Class.methods[] array, so they are INVISIBLE in the tree — a user cannot navigate to them from their Class at all (no path exists). MEASURED: robbin-req reproduced 3 unreachable exactly. This is the navigation face of the forward-edge model (R37.32): a Method not forward-referenced by any Class has no chain path to render under.

discoverySource.note: PO delivery-first capture (LAW 2): user-visible @390 defect, screenshot-checkable AC. Fix ships in parallel; capture does not block delivery.

model.crossRefNote: Surfaces the user-visible face of the traceability-integrity family (R37.29 referential-integrity / R37.32 forward-authoritative). Same root, but stated in what the USER SEES @390, not model contents.
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED — OPEN DEFECT on served v0.8.150; fix ships (expert), Tron prioritizes; screenshot-@390 verifies.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On 390px, every Method is reachable by navigation: expanding its Class shows it in the methods list. Screenshot: the 3 currently-orphaned methods appear under a Class, not nowhere.
The count of Method units in no Class.methods[] (baseline 3) is 0; a method with a shipped impl but no Class path is surfaced, never silently invisible.
